description: This PHP source file contains a unit test class 'LDAPSyncServiceTest' which tests various functionalities of LDAP synchronization service in the OrangeHRM application. It includes setup routines, multiple test cases for fetching LDAP entries, handling special characters, creating system users, and handling different LDAP configurations.

classes.name: LDAPSyncServiceTest
